name: Soft-Lit Sphere Sprite Generator
definition: Generates a 2D RGBA sprite representing a softly lit sphere with a restrained rough-plastic highlight, optimized for CPU-based point-cloud rendering without external renderer dependencies.
summary: The Soft-Lit Sphere Sprite Generator is a CPU-based procedural renderer that creates 2D RGBA sprites with rough-plastic highlights, avoiding GPU dependencies for point-cloud visualization.
